sources.label: Morphe patches for TIDAL - Spotify style swipe right to add to queue
sources.author: chukfinley TIDAL
patch_list: Adds a Spotify style swipe right gesture that adds the swiped item to the play queue, on every screen that lists tracks, albums, playlists or mixes.

sources.label: Dutch App
sources.author: Dutch App
patch_list: Lets TIDAL's car media browser accept a third-party Android Auto host such as DriveDeck or Gearslip. Only the host admission check changes; TIDAL's accounts, subscription, catalogue and playback services stay active.

sources.label: Morphe patches for TIDAL: search songs, albums and artists on Rate Your Music
sources.author: KYT
patch_list: Adds an option to the track, album and artist menus to search them on Rate Your Music.
